cohort: The study included 891 women with successive pregnancies admitted for delivery to DMCH's Obstetrics and Gynecology department in Laheriasarai, Bihar.
finding: The advanced maternal age group had significantly higher prevalence rates of preeclampsia, gestational hypertension, and GDM, as well as lower five-minute Apgar scores.
mod_finding: The advanced maternal age group was more likely to have a cesarean section, while the younger group was more likely to have a vaginal delivery.
